extraction.Name: Lizzie Shangreau
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want it, but that she was told that if she did not take it, the land would be taxes anyway and if she did not pay the taxes that the land would be sold to pay them
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged a quarter section of her land to Henry Lang of Black Hawk, So. Dak. for $500.00, because she could not pay the taxes and had to raise money for that purpose. I could not pay the mortgage so Mr. Lang took the land, and the taxes finally took the other quarter section.
extraction.Buyer: Henry Lang of Black Hawk, So. Dak. for $500.00 (mortgage/foreclosure); taxes took the other quarter section
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes and had to raise money for that purpose; could not pay the mortgage so Mr. Lang took the land, and the taxes finally took the other quarter section
extraction.Occupation/Income: I have my childrens land leased, but that is only a very little money, and I am compelled to depend on my relatives for most of my support
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent but in very poor health, suffering from epilepsy, gall stones and fainting spells, and unable to do any kind of work; has two minor children depending on her for support; has not received any assistance from the Government, State or County; states land was worth $3200.00 but only received $500.00 for it all; affidavit sworn November 5, 1928, County of Shannon, State of South Dakota
